verdict.rationale: ADK's own docs say it is "designed to be written by both humans and AI" and point coding assistants to "ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources", so first-party agent-oriented docs exist. However, nothing shows an llms.txt file or markdown doc endpoints. The probes returned 404 at the google.github.io root and at a malformed .md path, which does not concretely refute the adk-docs claim but leaves it unverified. Missing for 10: a documented llms.txt or llms-full.txt, a machine-readable markdown docs format, details on what the AI-aware resources contain and how to point an agent at them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources
